description: An announcement bar for Svelte 5 built from the SvGrid UI kit: a slim inverted bar above the app header with an SvBadge, one line of news, a changelog link and a dismiss button. Dismissing hides the bar and shows an SvToaster toast with Undo, and a Show announcement again SvButton in the page brings it back.

faq.question: How do I keep the bar hidden after a user dismisses it?
faq.answer: createAnnouncement() keeps visibility in bar.open. Create it with open: false so the bar starts hidden, read a key such as banner:exports-weekend:v1 from localStorage in onMount and call bar.show() when it is not set, and write the key in the onDismiss callback. Put a version in the key so the next announcement shows again.

faq.question: Why is the bar drawn with the foreground color?
faq.answer: The bar uses --sg-fg as its background and --sg-bg as its text, so it reads as a system message in light and dark themes without borrowing the accent color, which stays reserved for primary actions.

faq.question: What changes on a phone?
faq.answer: Below 640 px the New badge and the mock nav links are hidden, the message aligns left and wraps onto two lines, and the dismiss button stays top right.
